name: Turnly
title: Turnly · Your shifts at a glance
description: A free, open-source shift calendar for people who work shifts in Spain. No Pro, no ads, no account, and it works offline.
intro: A shift calendar for people who work shifts in Spain (healthcare, police, firefighters, industry, hospitality or any other sector): set up mornings, afternoons, nights, on-call shifts, post-night days and days off, and see your next shift at a glance. Everything is free, with no Pro version, ads or account, and when you change phones your shifts come with you without paying anything again.
key_facts: All free, no Pro · No ads · No account · Works offline · Open source · Five languages
features: A Today card with your next shift, next day off and work streak. The month as a grid or list, the agenda and the year, with your phone calendar events next to your shifts. Daily notes with photos, files and tasks. Compare up to six calendars to see the days you are all off.

Tap or drag to paint several days and, with “Add another shift”, put more than one on the same day. Copy, paste, undo and redo. A rotation wizard with a preview: rotating shifts, 24/72, 4×4, 6×4, 5×2, 2-2-3 or your own pattern, starting from the day of the cycle you are on.

An alarm per shift type that rings like an alarm clock and is scheduled a month ahead, plus note reminders. On Android, six widgets (today, week, month, agenda, two and four weeks) and “Silence the phone on my shifts”, which brings the sound back when they end.

Automatic backups you can check with “Test restore” and, on Android, one a day in the folder you choose (Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive…). Import LRHSoft Shifter backups, .ics, CSV or your phone calendar. With “Keep up to date”, your shifts go to your phone calendar; you can also save them as an .ics file.

Worked, night and public holiday hours, overtime and early leave by month, quarter, year or any dates, with your hours goal and hours bank. Hourly rate plus fixed, night and holiday premiums: estimated gross pay, and net pay with your withholding. PDF and CSV reports.

Vacation, personal days and leave balances per year, with carried-over days and when they expire. In the swap book you log the shifts you swap with colleagues, see who owes whom and apply them to the calendar.

Public holidays for Spain, with its regions and many municipalities, and for 21 more countries, all offline, plus your own. Make it yours: time and date format, currency, five accent colors, ready-made palettes for your shifts and a calendar background image.
privacy_summary: Your shifts, notes and absences are stored only on your phone: there is no account, no server of ours and no analytics.

The app sends no data or crash reports to anyone. The only things that leave your phone are what you choose to export or send to your phone calendar, and the system backup: on Android, the one in your Google account, end-to-end encrypted with your screen lock (without a screen lock, Turnly stays out of it); on iPhone, the iCloud or computer backup.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: Nothing. Turnly is completely free and open source: no ads, no Pro tier and no in-app purchases. Not when you change phones either: there is nothing to buy again.

faq.question: Do I need an account or an internet connection?
faq.answer: No. There is no account and everything works offline, public holidays included.

faq.question: How do I join the Google Play test?
faq.answer: Join the turnly-testers group on Google Groups with your Google account, accept the test at the Google Play link and install the app from the store. It updates itself.

faq.question: What about iPhone?
faq.answer: Yes: Turnly has been on the App Store since 10 November 2026, free, for iPhone with iOS 17 or later.

faq.question: How do I move Turnly to a new phone?
faq.answer: There are four ways, and all of them are free. Direct transfer: when you set up the new phone, copy the apps and data from the old one by cable or Wi-Fi; Turnly moves with them. Google backup: with Android backup turned on and a screen lock (PIN, pattern or password), Android stores Turnly encrypted in your Google account and brings it back when you set up the new phone with the same account (Android 9 or later). Without a screen lock, Turnly is left out of that backup. A .turnly file: in Settings › Backup, use “Export file” or “Save to device”; take it to the new phone and open it, or use “Import file”. Automatic backup to a folder (Android): it leaves one copy a day in the folder you choose; if that folder is in your cloud or you move it to the new phone, import the latest one. With the file or the folder, you first see what the backup contains, and nothing is replaced until you confirm it. Backups that stay inside the app are lost if you uninstall it without another copy.

faq.question: What if I want to start over?
faq.answer: In Settings, “Delete everything and start over” deletes your calendars, notes, absences and settings (only the language is kept) and takes you back to the first run. First, it saves a backup you can restore or keep somewhere else.
